interpretation: Mappings describe inspected present source and retained documentation, not an exhaustive historical line diff.

Original behavior and revision claims are supported by the cited local source, documented upstream references, or retained comparisons; source_inspection is not a fresh independent upstream execution.
Repository Git revisions, checkpoint revisions, framework package versions and historical evaluated revisions are distinct identifiers.
Existing tests and result receipts establish only their documented inputs, revisions, backends and tolerances; they were not rerun here.
Preserved behavior is the identified implementation contract, not a new assertion of numerical or clinical equivalence.
Historical extraction prompts record plans; destination source and execution evidence determine implemented and verified outcomes.
Evidence paths resolve inside the current entry repository unless repository explicitly names a different entry; line endpoints are inclusive.

repository.name: medmlx-core
repository.summary: Shared runtime and numerical primitives used by model ports; combines newly added Metal admission/checkpoint contracts with Torch/MONAI-compatible array, convolution, resampling and sliding-window helpers. It is not a standalone model port.

changes.original_behavior: Individual upstream models/frameworks can have CPU/CUDA device selection; this package itself has no single upstream model origin.
changes.mlx_behavior: Centralize Darwin-arm64 admission, supported MLX version checks, Metal availability, explicit GPU selection and memory reporting; unsupported hosts or unavailable Metal fail explicitly.
changes.rationale: Give independently packaged native models one explicit runtime contract.

changes.original_behavior: Torch checkpoints require Torch deserialization and may contain nested tensor payloads.
changes.mlx_behavior: Provide optional conversion-only Torch loading with weights_only=True by default, explicit trusted legacy opt-out, duplicate-safe host mappings and structured missing-extra errors.
changes.rationale: Keep runtime inference independent from reference/deserialization frameworks.

changes.original_behavior: Torch volumetric public tensors use NCDHW and convolution weights OI-K or IO-K; MLX convolutions consume channel-last arrays and output-first/channel-last kernels.
changes.mlx_behavior: Centralize NCDHW<->NDHWC, convolution and transpose-convolution weight permutations, and volume-token reshaping; keep model-specific topology/label semantics outside core.

changes.original_behavior: Torch functional operations define GroupNorm, convolutions, pooling, interpolation and padding used by consumers.
changes.mlx_behavior: Implement shared MLX ops; GroupNorm reshapes each group into a layer_norm reduction then restores channel order and affine terms; expose source-facing NCDHW signatures around channel-last convolution.

changes.original_behavior: MONAI MaisiConvolution splits spatial work with overlap, crop and integer size-ratio rules.
changes.mlx_behavior: Reimplement split forward/transposed 3D convolution around shared MLX ops, retaining source split axis and crop semantics rather than changing model topology.

changes.original_behavior: Torch kernel-2/stride-2 transposed convolution defines decoder output; native MLX 0.32.3 lazy decoder consumers were documented to corrupt large outputs.
changes.mlx_behavior: Dispatch FP32 zero-padding/output-padding kernel-2/stride-2 cases to deconv2x_ncdhw: compute eight matrix-product phases and interleave output. Retain native MLX for other geometry/dtypes without inserting graph evaluation boundaries.
changes.rationale: Repair a documented lazy-consumer numerical defect while preserving the operator contract.

changes.original_behavior: MONAI sliding_window_inference defines window stride, padding, Gaussian weights, batching, coordinates and output crop semantics.
changes.mlx_behavior: Run predictor windows on Metal while accumulating in ordered host NumPy arrays; retain source stride/edge shift/symmetric padding and weighted dtype behavior. Reject CPU prediction and unsupported scaled/multiple outputs, buffering, process_fn and MetaTensor paths.
changes.rationale: Separate model execution from the host output stitcher; explicit unsupported contracts prevent silent degradation.

changes.original_behavior: Torch/MONAI graph layers include linear, affine norms, batch norms, residual blocks and deconvolution.
changes.mlx_behavior: Supply a shared ChannelLastGraph and fused upsample-plus-skip helpers, with independent source-layer and complete seeded graph comparisons; leave model checkpoint keys and image workflow ownership to consumers.

changes.original_behavior: Source CPU FP32 and Metal FP32 differ in reduction/FMA/exponential rounding even for equivalent helper formulas.
changes.mlx_behavior: Version operation-specific numerical budgets, exact-copy/discrete contracts and independent source-generated fixture archives; isolate layer-stage comparisons from cumulative full-graph budgets.
changes.rationale: Helper qualification must not be promoted to released-model or clinical equivalence.

preserved_behavior: Source-facing NCDHW shapes, Torch convolution layouts, MONAI split/window semantics and predictor-channel ordering are explicit shared contracts.
Model topology, checkpoint names, labels, geometry and pre/postprocessing remain owned by model packages.

findings: Docs record seven independent small helper archives and a v0.1.2 wheel run passing 219 tagged tests on Metal.
Transpose-convolution note includes a checkpoint-free reproducer and separates measured corruption from inferred upstream cause.
Technical docs retain historical Ruff/Pyright backlog; no current lint/typecheck status is inferred.
git status reported clean at inspection.
limits: No helper tests, reproducer, lint, typecheck or performance probes were run for this inventory.
Helper fixtures do not qualify consumer checkpoints, full-volume performance, clinical accuracy or models using other MONAI revisions.

unresolved: No single Torch-to-MLX model history applies to this shared library; mappings distinguish added contracts from algorithm ports.
Historical static-analysis counts in docs may be stale and were not refreshed.
